status: frozen after the calibration-only failure diagnosis passed its continuous control and identified curvature in all seven straight-line branches, but before any held-out filter-wheel event energy was recalculated or inspected
purpose: Test a parameter-free common/differential gain decomposition on four leave-one-fiducial-segment-out main-array closures before using it in any A2319 science interval.

physical_model.equation: T_i(t) = C_12(t) + D_i(t), where C_12 is the exact continuously illuminated calibration-pixel TEMP_FIT history and D_i = T_i^FW - C_12 is the pixel-specific differential response inferred only from non-held-out filter-wheel fiducials
physical_model.common_mode: linearly interpolate the valid native calibration-pixel TEMP_FIT rows in time without smoothing, rescaling, or fitting their amplitudes
physical_model.differential_mode: fit one time-linear D_i model per pixel to all valid rows in the three non-held-out fiducial segments

inputs.event_selection: frozen segment start <= TIME <= frozen segment stop AND PIXEL != 12 AND ITYPE == 0

cross_validation.held_out_unit: one complete frozen 10,800-second-gap fiducial segment and its corresponding ObsID
cross_validation.training_units: the other three complete fiducial segments
cross_validation.candidate_history_time_grid: all valid calibration-pixel gain-history times inside the held-out segment
cross_validation.control: apply the untouched native held-out Fe-55 gain history to exactly the same selected filter-wheel events
cross_validation.candidate: apply the common/differential history whose D_i fit excludes the held-out segment
fit_outputs: whole-main-array Mn K-alpha shift and Gaussian FWHM
per-pixel Mn K-alpha shift and Gaussian FWHM for all 35 main-array pixels

terminal_gate.failure_rule: If any fold fails, do not freeze a science-interval gain application; report whether endpoint extrapolation or interior interpolation failed.
terminal_gate.pass_rule: If all four folds pass, authorize freezing the same no-refit equation for the seven A2319 science branches, but do not apply it to a cluster event in this protocol.

claim_boundary: The held-out events are onboard Fe-55 calibration events, not cluster photons.
A pass establishes only that common/differential gain decomposition predicts omitted calibration intervals closely enough to freeze a science-application protocol.
No calibration nuisance coefficient is a Sigma Gravity constant or may be selected using a cluster velocity.
